study type: Combination of clinical studies and in vitro study
exposure: Methylation status of SREBF1 and LDLR genes
Expression of SREBF1 and LDLR genes
cohort: Three groups of women: non-pregnant women of childbearing age, women in early pregnancy, and women at delivery.
finding: Vitamin B12 deficiency was associated with higher cholesterol levels and altered lipid profiles in pregnant and non-pregnant women, likely by reducing methylation potential and influencing the expression of genes involved in cholesterol biosynthesis.
